procedural_matters: GBR 322 -Joy- was represented by Francesco Nasato (tactician of GBR 322).
ITA 4123 -Capitani Coraggiosi- was represented by Federico Felcini (co-owner of ITA 4123).
facts: GBR 322 was beyond hailing distance with ITA 4123 at the time of the incident.
GBR 322 submitted the protest 20 minutes after mooring.
GBR 322 and ITA 4123 are moored in the same harbour.
ITA 4123 was informed of the protest by receiving a message from the International Jury on Telegram.
GBR 322 did not try to make contact with ITA 4123 before the hearing.
conclusions: ITA 4123 was beyond hailing distance, and GBR 322 did not inform ITA 4123 of the protest at the first reasonable opportunity, as required by RRS 60.2(b)(1).
decision: The protest is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
